item.title: Officer says Myles Gray was restrained face-down for several minutes before death
item.description: A Vancouver police officer has testified at a public hearing into the 2015 police-involved death of Myles Gray that Gray was handcuffed and hobbled, and struggled while being restrained face down by officers for several minutes before his body went limp.
